claims.evidence: MaxQuant summary.txt/mqpar.xml assign the 42 raws to experiments 1-14 (file tag _S<n>_F1..F3 = experiment n, fractions 1-3). Each experiment is one 1:1 SILAC mix of a light and a heavy HEK293 culture of the same transduced line, one given doxycycline and one ddH2O for 4 h (PRIDE sample protocol; Supp Fig S3A, S6D). Each source = one SILAC-labelled culture in one experiment, so no name denotes two physical samples. Experiments 13-14 are not annotated (see limitations).

claims.value: dox channel = SILAC heavy in S1, S3, S5, S8, S9, S11; SILAC light in S2, S4, S6, S7, S10, S12; the other channel untreated
claims.evidence: Explicit design: light = Arg-0/Lys-0, heavy = Arg-10/Lys-8 (PRIDE protocol; summary.txt Labels1 Arg10;Lys8, Multiplicity 2); Supp Fig S3A forward scheme light -dox / heavy +dox (4 h); Supp Methods: phosphosites "present in both forward and reverse (label-swap) experiments"; Supp Fig S6D: both light and heavy lysates contain -dox and +dox samples of every construct. Which experiment is forward or reverse is not stated anywhere, so the orientation is read from the induced transgene itself: median log2 normalized H/L of BRAF peptides aa 380-766 (present in every BRAF construct) S1..S12 = +2.35, -2.67, +1.87, -1.80, +1.15, -1.44, -2.26, +2.32, +2.77, -2.36, +1.56, -1.89 (n = 6-15 peptides each; identity.tsv). Positive = heavy is the induced (+dox) culture. Every construct pair has one forward and one reverse experiment, as the label-swap design requires.

claims.evidence: Constructs: HEK293 lines transduced with pInducer20 (dox-inducible) GFP, BRAF-WT, BRAF-Kinase, BRAF-V600E, AGAP3-BRAF, DLG1-BRAF, TRIM24-BRAF (Supp Methods; Supp Fig S5/S6 legends) = 7 lines x forward/reverse = 14 experiments. The construct table (figshare 39979488) gives each construct's 5' cloning primer: AGAP3-BRAF, DLG1-BRAF (ATGCCGGTCCGGAAG = DLG1 MPVRK...), TRIM24-BRAF (ATGGAGGTGGCGGTGGAG = TRIM24 MEVAVE...), BRAF-WT and BRAF-V600E (ATGGCGGCGCTGAGC = BRAF MAALS..., full length), BRAF-kinase (ATGGACTTGATTAGAGACC = M + BRAF DLIRD at residue 381). No source states which experiment number holds which construct; the assignment is derived from the transgene products in the deposited MaxQuant tables (identity.tsv, peppos.txt), each pair matched one-to-one: (i) AGAP3 peptides (aa 217-316) change only in S1/S2 (+3.13/-3.63); (ii) DLG1 N-terminal peptides (aa 70-141) only in S3/S4 (+1.69/-1.38); (iii) TRIM24 N-terminal peptides (aa 8-88) only in S5/S6 (+1.81/-2.11); (iv) BRAF N-terminal peptides (aa 147-363, absent from the kinase and fusion constructs) only in S7/S8 (-2.10/+2.22) and S11/S12 (+1.43/-3.07) -> full-length BRAF-WT / BRAF-V600E; (v) S9/S10 carry BRAF aa 380-766 peptides (+2.77/-2.36) but no N-terminal BRAF and no partner peptides -> BRAF-kinase (aa 381-766); (vi) WT vs V600E (S7/S8 vs S11/S12): Supp Fig S3B V600E-specific marker sites are induced in S11/S12: CDC27 S364 +2.45/+2.81 in dox orientation (quantified otherwise only once, S5 +2.19), MARCKS S101 +2.44/+2.63 (highest of all pairs; S7/S8 +0.26/+0.32); Supp Fig S3D gives V600E the largest up-regulated set (202) and S11/S12 has the largest set in the deposit (149 sites >1.5 log2 in both experiments; sitecounts.txt); S7/S8 shows almost no ERK activation (MAPK1 Y175 +0.57/+0.69 in dox orientation; Y175 is the numbering of the MaxQuant leading protein B4DHN0 as in Fig S3B = canonical P28482 Y187). (vii) Fusion marker sites of Supp Fig S3B land in the assigned pairs: EPHA2 S897 (AGAP3) S1/S2 +2.50/+2.34; DLG1 S138 (DLG1) S3/S4 only +1.48/+1.38; FAM21A S288 (DLG1) S3/S4 +2.17/+2.52; EGR1 S26 and REPS1 S143 (TRIM24) S5/S6 +3.05/+3.13 and +2.52/+2.57 (figsites.txt). (viii) BRAF-WT vs BRAF-kinase (S7/S8 vs S9/S10) conflicts with the Supp Fig S3B/D kinase profile; see the separate conflict claim. The resulting order AGAP3, DLG1, TRIM24, WT, kinase, V600E, (GFP) is also the row order of the construct table. Value strings name the pInducer20 vector (Supp Methods).

claims.evidence: CONFLICT (recorded under campaign rule 6). AGAINST the assignment: the authors' labelled BRAF-Kinase result in Supp Fig S3B/D is 8 up-regulated sites, 37.5% shared (Venn), no MAPK1/MAPK3 activation-loop rows in the kinase column, and one kinase-only row, RAF1 S465. In the deposit that profile matches S7/S8: RAF1 S465 (peptide IGSGSFGTVYK, whose sequence MaxQuant also maps to BRAF P15056 aa 463-473) is induced +2.27/+2.62 in S7/S8 and not quantified in S9/S10; S7/S8 has 7 up-sites (4 shared with another pair here; 3 per the independent review), S9/S10 has 14 (11 shared) plus MAPK1 Y175 +1.69/+3.12 and MAPK3 Y165 +1.74/+3.68 in dox orientation (f2_check.txt, figsites.txt). FOR the assignment: (a) construct sequence: the BRAF-kinase attR1 primer starts ATG GAC TTG ATT AGA GAC C = M + BRAF aa 381 (construct table), so it cannot produce the BRAF N-terminal peptides/sites SNPKSPQKPIVR (aa 147, S151), SSSAPNVHINTIEPVNIDDLIR (aa 363, S363/S365) and DRSSSAPNV... (aa 361), which are dox-induced in S7/S8 (-2.44/+2.47, -2.24/+2.23) and in S11/S12, and flat in S9/S10 (S365 +0.19/+0.37) (peppos.txt, identity.tsv); (b) Supp Fig S6C: BRAF-Kinase raises pERK at 4 h of dox, BRAF-WT only weakly; (c) Supp Fig S3C KSEA: RAF1, MAP2K2, MAP2K1 are top hits for BRAF-Kinase, none for BRAF-WT (RPS6KB1, PRKCA, ATM, PRKCG, AKT2). WHY the sequence evidence wins: rule 6 ranks explicit statements and data above inference. The construct sequence (explicit) plus the directly measured transgene peptides (data) identify which pair carries the truncated construct, and two further author figures (S6C, S3C) agree. The S3B/D kinase profile is a processed summary (protein-normalised, t-tested, thresholded). Its single kinase-only marker is a peptide that is also BRAF sequence present in both constructs, and it is quantified only in S7/S8 and S4. Decision by the campaign coordinator after the independent review: keep S7-S10 as annotated, conflict documented; an author key would resolve it.

limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: experiments S13 and S14 (6 raws: 20181213_F1_RM_CHS_0200_TIO2_RVhPH_S13_F1/F2/F3.raw, _S14_F1/F2/F3.raw) are not annotated. By elimination they are the pInducer20-GFP control line (the 7th construct; no BRAF/partner peptide changes, median BRAF aa 380-766 log2 H/L +0.04 / +0.12), but GFP is not in the searched human database, so no transgene peptide shows which SILAC channel received doxycycline, and no source states it. Rows with a not-available treatment would pool unrelated cultures (campaign rule 7). Recorded in annotations/BLOCKED.md.

The experiment-number -> construct and label-orientation map is DATA-DERIVED (transgene-product peptides, BRAF N-terminal coverage against the construct start codons in the construct table, Supp Fig S3B marker sites, and Supp Fig S3D set sizes); it is not stated by the authors. WEAKEST LINK: BRAF-WT (S7/S8) vs BRAF-kinase (S9/S10). The construct sequence and transgene N-terminal BRAF peptides, Supp Fig S6C and Supp Fig S3C put the kinase construct at S9/S10. The Supp Fig S3B/D BRAF-Kinase profile (8 sites, 37.5% shared, no MAPK rows, kinase-only RAF1 S465) matches S7/S8 instead. The sequence evidence was given priority (rule 6), and the coordinator decided to keep S7-S10 with the conflict documented (see the conflict claim). An author key is needed to settle it. WT vs V600E is well supported: the Fig S3B V600E-specific CDC27 S364 is induced only in S11/S12, and MARCKS S101 is highest there. The fusions are supported by partner peptides and the Fig S3B marker sites.

Main paper (Mol Cancer Res, not open access) was not retrieved; Methods come from the PRIDE protocols and the AACR figshare Supplementary Materials and Methods / Figures / legends. The figshare item titled "Supplementary Table 1" (KSEA) actually contains the construct/primer table (Table S4 content); the KSEA table was not found.
PRIDE v3 file-list endpoint timed out (project endpoint answered); the file list comes from the ProteomeXchange record, cross-checked with the FTP listing and README.txt (42 raws + 1 MaxQuant zip).

characteristics[passage number] = not available: Supp Methods says HEK293 "were kept in culture for 16 passages until final experiments were performed", which does not give the passage number of the SILAC cultures unambiguously. characteristics[age] / ancestry / individual = not available (Cellosaurus gives Fetus, no population).

S9/S10 (BRAF-kinase) carry a label-specific component that does not flip with the label swap: 152 phosphosites with the same raw H/L sign beyond +/-1.5 log2 in both experiments (other pairs 9-15), and wider per-experiment SD of log2 ratios (0.88/0.92 vs 0.45-0.67) (f2_check.txt). This suggests a culture or labelling difference between the light and heavy cultures beyond the dox induction. It does not change the annotation, but users comparing S9/S10 should expect a label effect.

Phosphosite numbering in this manifest follows the MaxQuant leading protein, as in Supp Fig S3B: MAPK1 Y175 / T173 are on isoform B4DHN0 and correspond to canonical P28482 Y187 / T185. MAPK3 Y165 is on isoform H0YDL8 and corresponds to canonical P27361 Y204 (PhosphoSites.txt "Positions within proteins").
Match between runs was on across all 42 raws (including S13/S14); the annotated runs keep the same search parameters, which describe the search they went through.
